limits: No manual VoiceOver, NVDA, or other assistive-technology certification was performed or claimed.

Focused 200%-root-text pixel inspection covered seven visualization surfaces in Firefox; the maintained automated visual matrix covered the complete required catalog across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

The adverse run is a desktop Chromium observation without a universal performance threshold; it does not establish lower-powered-device, field Core Web Vitals, paint, or universal performance behavior.
The owned fixtures do not establish universal pixel equivalence across every consumer environment.
